# Brenden Jarrett

> Brenden Jarrett is a game audio composer and sound designer who has been making music since 2017. He writes ambient electronic, IDM and instrumental electronic music, and composes soundtracks and designs sound for video games and film. He is open to scoring and sound design work on indie and studio game projects.

## Sound and influences

- Genres: ambient electronic, IDM (intelligent dance music), instrumental electronic, video game music.
- Electronic influences: Aphex Twin, Boards of Canada, Com Truise, Squarepusher.
- Game audio influences: Bungie's Halo and Marathon (Martin O'Donnell), Valve's Half-Life and Portal, Playdead's INSIDE (Martin Stig Andersen), The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (Jeremy Soule), and Koji Kondo.
- Tools: Ableton Live (main DAW), Wwise (game audio middleware), Adobe Premiere Pro, Sequential Prophet-6, Korg Minilogue, EFNOTE drums, Ableton Push 2.

## Music

- [Music](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/): all releases, with track previews.
- [Quailentime](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/quailentime/) (album, 2026): synthesizers, piano, drum machines and guitars; loud and vivacious, then soft and ambient.
- [Grandpa's Clothes EP](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/grandpas-clothes-ep/) (EP, 2025): acoustic instruments coupled with synthesizers.
- [ACOLDAUS](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/acoldaus/) (album, 2024): a collection of lost, deleted and unfinished songs.
- [Cleft](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/cleft/) (album, 2023): astronomical, with large sweeping reverbs and experimental synthesizers.
- [Effervescent](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/effervescent/) (album, 2022): electronica in four segments: beats, ambience, piano and guitar.
- [Tomorrow Is Only a Dream Away](https://brendenjarrett.com/music/tomorrow-is-only-a-dream-away/) (single, 2018).
- Streaming: [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0vUuyq2k7Zz5etqPfTC1cY), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/artist/brenden-jarrett/1651731935), [Bandcamp](https://brendenjarrett.bandcamp.com/), [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/brendenjarrett), [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/channel/UCkjo_ITGxskD-G90v71qWeg).

## Writing on game audio

- [Balatro's Polyrhythmic & Polychrome Score](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/balatros-polyrhythmic-and-polychrome/): LouisF's score for Balatro.
- [Going Outside the Norm by Scoring INSIDE a Real Human Skull](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/going-outside-the-norm-by-scoring/): Martin Stig Andersen's sound for Playdead's INSIDE.
- [Skyrim Helps 903 of Us Sleep](https://brendenjarrett.com/articles/how-skyrims-score-has-cast-a-cathartic/): Jeremy Soule's score for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.

## Work with Brenden

- [Contact](https://brendenjarrett.com/contact/): hire Brenden to compose the soundtrack or design the sound for a video game or film.
- [About](https://brendenjarrett.com/about/): background, training and instruments.
